lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×50

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: I got your photo.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Thanks to you, I received permission to begin developing the next Volt Jr.
I'm glad.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: That photo was very impressive.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Very convincing.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: However, I'm not sure if you know this, but

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Raptures in that area are primarily equipped with beam guns.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: That would mean there should have been burn marks near the impact points,

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: but that certainly didn't seem to be the case in the photo.
It was crushed by a building that toppled after being destroyed by a Rapture.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: It doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Everything worked out in the end.
You won't pursue this any further?

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: What do you mean?
Nothing.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Did I ever tell you

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: why I chose to model these robots after dogs?
No.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: It's for one very simple reason.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: I like dogs.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: So with that being said, I think everything worked out quite nicely.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: It was a pleasure working with you again.
